group-chat.prompt: Is the Sony WH-1000XM5 worth its price?
group-chat.text:
Round-table on: Is the Sony WH-1000XM5 worth its price?

**Value:** From a pricing and value standpoint, the WH-1000XM5 sits at the premium end of the market, but its feature set—top-tier noise cancellation, advanced audio codecs, and robust build quality—justifies the cost for users prioritizing superior sound and comfort. If you're comparing to mid-range alternatives, the extra spend buys tangible performance upgrades, making it a strong value for those who will use those features regularly.

**Quality:** Review consensus often highlights the WH-1000XM5's improved durability and comfortable, lightweight design, which stand out in daily use. Long-term owners report reliable performance and minimal wear, suggesting Sony’s manufacturing quality matches its premium pricing.

modes.description: The orchestrator LLM calls call_specialist_agent to route to a specialist. Single-hop: one specialist per turn, decided by the model.
modes.label: Tool Router
modes.name: tool

modes.description: MAF HandoffBuilder mesh: the orchestrator mechanically hands control to a specialist and back, instead of the LLM deciding per-turn via a tool call.
modes.label: Handoff Mesh
modes.name: handoff

modes.description: MAF concurrent workflow: reviews, stock, and price history are fetched in parallel, merged, and (if in stock) followed by a sequential shipping estimate — then synthesized into one recommendation. Contrast with `tool`, which would make these same calls one at a time, serially.
modes.label: Pre-Purchase Research (fan-out/fan-in)
modes.name: workflow:pre-purchase

modes.description: MAF sequential workflow: eligibility check, then a policy gate that decides whether a person must approve (ctx.request_info — structurally different from the middleware-based approval flow `tool` mode uses; see shared/hitl.py vs this workflow's policy-gate executor), and only then return initiation, replacement search, loyalty discount and finalize.
modes.label: Return & Replace (sequential + in-workflow HITL)
modes.name: workflow:return-replace

modes.description: MAF sequential workflow: named panelists take turns over a shared transcript — each sees prior turns before speaking — then a moderator synthesizes a verdict. Distinct from tool routing (one specialist call) and handoff (control changes hands); every panelist speaks.
modes.label: Group Chat (round-table debate)
modes.name: group-chat
